### Install

Mozilla signed this add-on, so it installs in Firefox 140 or later and in the browsers built on it
(Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp, Waterfox and others), on the desktop.

1. Download the `.xpi` file from the assets below.
2. Open it in your browser: drag it onto a browser window, or open `about:addons`, click the gear
   icon and choose **Install Add-on From File…**.
3. Accept the install prompt. It lists the sites the recorder works on (Google Meet, Zoom,
   Microsoft Teams); leave them all allowed.

**Zen:** the same steps. You do not need to change any pref, because the file is signed.

**Updates are automatic.** The browser checks for a new version once a day and installs it. After
an update the popup may show **Grant access** for a service that is new in that version: Firefox
asks for each site's permission separately.

The `-sources.zip` asset holds the source code this version was built from.

### About

> Zen Recorder is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by
> Zen Browser or its team. The maintainer uses Zen Browser, which is why the recorder targets
> Firefox-based browsers.

Nothing leaves your machine: no servers, no accounts, no uploads, no telemetry. The
[privacy policy](https://zenfully-org.github.io/zen-recorder/privacy.html) says what the extension
stores and where.
